  def policy(hand: list[str], target: int) -> str:

      def hand_value(m: int) -> int:

          for i in range(13):

                  c = all_cards[i]
                  if c == "A":
                      total += 11
                      aces += 1
                  elif c in ("J", "Q", "K"):
                      total += 10
                  else:
                      total += int(c)
          # Adjust aces
          while total > target and aces > 0:
              total -= 10
              aces -= 1
          return total

      if current_val > target:

          v = hand_value(m)

          # Find remaining cards
          remaining_indices = [i for i in range(13) if not (m >> i) & 1]
